action.description: bootstrap = self-check dependencies and return setup steps (run this first on a new device); status = services + tunnel state; look = read the accessibility tree of the frontmost app (default); readList = scroll through a long list and return every row (not just the visible ones); apps = list installed apps (name/version/bundle id/install source) or one app's detail; tap = tap by text/index or x,y; press = long press; type = send ASCII keyboard input (backspaces first if asked); paste = put text on the clipboard and paste it (works for Chinese/emoji/long text); ime = type pinyin then tap the Chinese candidate; scrollTo = find an element in a list, scrolling if needed; swipe = quick flick; drag = press, hold, then move (reorder icons, drag sliders); back = swipe in from the left edge (iOS back); keyCombo = hardware-key shortcut such as cmd+v; waitFor = poll until text appears/disappears; expect = assert text is present/absent; button = hardware button; screenshot = PNG only (opt-in); launch = open an app by bundle id; home = go to Home Screen; wait = pause; sequence = run steps[] in one tunnel; macro = save/run/list named sequences ({save:true,name,steps} / {name} / {list:true}).

text.description: action=tap: pick the element whose label/identifier contains this text. action=type/paste: the text to put in. action=ime: the pinyin letters to type.

field.description: For action=type/paste: tap the element with this label first (usually a search field), then type/paste.

name.description: For action=button: which hardware button to press.

absent.description: For action=waitFor: wait until the text disappears instead of appears.

tap.description: For action=scrollTo/waitFor: tap the element once it is found.

format.description: For action=look: json returns an elements array (default); text returns one compact line per element, about a third fewer tokens.

filter.description: For action=look: only return elements whose label or identifier matches. Plain text is a case-insensitive substring; /regex/ is treated as a regular expression.

maxWidth.description: For screenshots: maximum width in pixels before re-encoding, default 900; 0 keeps the original size. Images are not upscaled.

imageFormat.description: For screenshots: jpeg (default, much smaller) or png (lossless, large).

diff.description: For sequence steps: also return what changed since the previous look in the same sequence (added/removed/moved).

retryNext.description: For action=tap with observe: if the screen did not change, try this many more matching candidates.

pinyin.description: For action=ime: the pinyin letters to type, e.g. dianchi.

expect.description: For action=ime: the Chinese word you expect, e.g. 电池. Used to pick the candidate chip.

imeSettleMs.description: For action=ime: wait after typing pinyin before reading candidates, default 600.

enter.description: For action=type: press Return after typing.

backspaces.description: For action=type: press Backspace this many times before typing (clears an existing value). text may be omitted when only clearing.

segments.description: For action=drag: how many intermediate move samples, default 20.

focusMs.description: For action=type: wait after focusing the field, default 700.

exact.description: For action=tap: require the label to equal the text exactly.

index.description: For action=tap: element index `i` from the last look (a fresh tree is read first, so re-look if the screen changed).

x.description: Tap target X in logical points (when not using text/index).

y.description: Tap target Y in logical points.

steps.description: For action=sequence: array of step objects ({action, ...}). For action=swipe: integer sample count.

observe.description: After tap/type/swipe/launch, read the tree again and return it as `after` (tap also returns `changed: true|false`).

ifNotFound.description: For action=tap: what to do when no element matches. Default throw; skip returns {tapped:null,skipped:true,visible:[...]}.

direction.description: For action=scrollTo/readList: which way to look first. down = further into the list (default).

align.description: For action=tap: where inside the element's frame to hit. Default center; left/right are inset 8pt so they stay on the control.

dx.description: For action=tap: extra offset in points from the aligned point (e.g. align:right with dx:-20 shoots just before the chevron).

dy.description: For action=tap: vertical offset in points from the row's centre.

mods.description: For action=keyCombo: modifiers, comma or plus separated — cmd, shift, alt, ctrl. Default cmd.

key.description: For action=keyCombo: one ASCII character, e.g. "v" for cmd+v, "a" for cmd+a.

usage.description: For action=keyCombo: raw HID usage code instead of key (0x50 = Left arrow, 0x4f = Right).

save.description: For action=macro: store name+steps instead of running them.

delete.description: For action=macro: remove the named macro.

list.description: For action=macro: list the saved macros.

maxPages.description: For action=readList: how many screens to scan before giving up, default 10. It stops earlier when the list stops moving.

observeMs.description: For action=paste: wait after the paste gesture before observing, default 500.

maxScrolls.description: For action=scrollTo: how many swipes per direction, default 3.

tryBoth.description: For action=scrollTo: if the first direction fails, tap the status bar to jump to the top and sweep the other way. Default true.

limit.description: For look: maximum number of elements to return, default 150.

includeUnlabeled.description: For look: also return elements without a label (switches, empty cells). Off by default to keep the payload small.

screenshot.description: For look: also capture a PNG and return its path. Costly (about 450 ms and ~640 KB), use only when the visual matters.

holdMs.description: For tap: how long the finger stays down on a raw x/y tap, default 50. For drag: how long to hold before moving, default 600 (a short hold behaves like a slow scroll).

settleMs.description: Wait before the follow-up observation, default 900 for tap, 600 for swipe, 1200 for launch.

timeoutMs.description: Budget for one tree read, default 8000.

graceMs.description: How long to wait for the complete AdditionalData push after InitialDump, default 300 (measured: Initial and Additional agree 9/10 times). Pass 0 for fastest reads, 1200+ when you suspect a long list is truncated.

retries.description: How many times to retry a read that comes back empty or fails, default 2.

bundleId.description: For action=launch: bundle identifier, e.g. com.apple.Preferences. For action=apps: return that one app's detail (version, min OS, URL schemes) instead of the list.

terminateExisting.description: For action=launch: restart the app instead of foregrounding it.

out.description: Optional absolute path for the screenshot. Defaults to phone-use-last-screen.* in the temporary directory, so runs never write into the skill package.

refresh.description: Drop the cached tunnel and re-open it (only matters in serve mode).

applicationType.description: For action=apps: which apps to include. Default User (the ones the user installed).
